points.description: States TRUE (the OS can still schedule READY processes without the timer interrupt).
Justifies with the idea that other events, such as system calls (or other events like I/O, process exit/blocking), give the OS opportunities to run the scheduler and switch to another process.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if the justification is vague, e.g. says OS has other chances to schedule but names no event, or names an event without linking it to scheduling.

rubric.notes: Full marks: says TRUE and gives the reason that system calls or other events let the OS schedule another process, in any wording. Part marks: TRUE with a vague reason (e.g. "OS has other ways to switch") earns about 1 mark. A FALSE answer, or TRUE with no justification, earns 0, since no correct justification means no marks.
